title: Merged classroom group participant list
goal: Maps and merges nested lists into one-level arrays.
summary: Each classroom has a set of registration names, and the sign-in system receives a flat list. Arrange by classroom order first, then by registration order within it.
tasks: completes participantNames(rooms), each rooms element contains a names array.
merges all names, preserving order and duplicate names. Empty classrooms and empty lists will not add entries.

example.code:
const groups = [{ items: ['wood'] }, { items: ['tape', 'paper'] }];
groups.flatMap((group) => group.items); // ['wood', 'tape', 'paper']
example.note: flatMap first gets an array for each item, and then flattens the result.

hint: callback returns room.names to avoid wrapping it with extra [].
